name: Pipeliners - Coolidge Page Copy Draft 2026-09-30
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-09-30

# Summary
Full draft copy for https://pipelinersusa.com/coolidge/ built from the Batch 1 brief. Draft only; every local fact comes from the live page, and claims needing Scott are marked [CONFIRM].

# Contents
- SEO settings: title "Sewer Line Repair & Repiping in Coolidge, AZ | Pipeliners" (57 chars), meta (152 chars), keep /coolidge/, Service + FAQPage in OTTO matched to the FAQ.
- Hero H1 and an intro naming clay, cast iron and bituminized fibre (Orangeburg) laterals and camera-first work.
- 4 benefit cards (one flagged [CONFIRM] on the 30% savings, since then approved).
- H2 sections: how trenchless repair works in Coolidge (1925 town history, cotton era pipe types), when to replace instead of line (Orangeburg deforms), "Do you repipe homes in Coolidge?" (ePIPE vs whole-house repipe), clearing clogs camera-first, hidden leak detection [CONFIRM], and an FAQ.

# Status against current rules
The repipe section says "Yes. Pipeliners repipes Coolidge homes", which conflicts with Scott's Oct 1 answer (no full repipes) and the rule against adding repipe claims. Coolidge was later restructured (Oct 10) and given Quick Facts (Oct 13); see [Pipeliners - Fix Log](lib:brain-pipeliners-fix-log).
